description: This file implements the MediaKeysModuleService class, which manages media key sessions and client connections for a media DRM system, interfacing with the ICdmService. It handles creation, destruction, and management of media key sessions, as well as client connection handling and IPC service export.

classes.name: MediaKeysModuleService
classes.description: Implements the media keys management service, handling client connections, media key session operations, and IPC service export.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, registers the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, cleans up associated media key handles, and destroys media keys.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates a new media keys instance for a given key system and associates it with the client.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys a media keys instance identified by handle.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists within a media key session.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session for a media keys instance.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a key session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads a session by its ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes a key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the limit for LDL sessions.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error for a session.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the DRM time.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.
